machine_length: <int> Length of the cutting machine in which patterns are configured.
num_products: <int> Number of distinct product types to be cut.
num_patterns: <int> Number of available cutting pattern slots.
num_groups: <int> Number of product groups, where products sharing the same maximum pieces per pattern belong to the same group.
cost_setup_pattern: <int> Time cost incurred once for each cutting pattern that is used.
cost_repetition: <int> Time cost incurred for each repetition of any cutting pattern.
cost_knife_setup: <number, optional> Additional setup time per knife; required only for cscp_with_knife_dependent_setups.
x_i_forced_zero: <bool, optional> True for closed_ended_cscp, where all extra-piece quantities must be zero.
M: <int> Upper bound on the number of repetitions any single pattern may have, equal to the maximum demand among all products.

products.id: <int> Unique identifier of the product type.
products.length: <int> Length of one piece of this product type.
products.demand: <int> Number of pieces of this product type that must be produced.
products.N_i: <int> Maximum number of pieces of this product type that can fit within a single cutting pattern.

groups: <dict, key: '{N_i_value}'> List of product IDs that share the same maximum pieces per pattern value, grouping products with identical fitting capacity.
